critical_code_review_comments: i18n.js stays namespace duplication is clean — all 36+ new keys exist in both en.translation.stays (lines 932-986) and he.translation.stays (lines 1910-1964). No duplicate-key collisions inside the new block.
QuickChips.jsx correctly includes i18n.language in the useMemo/useEffect dependency arrays so chip labels (and holiday chip labels) re-translate live on locale switch.
WhenPicker and WherePicker both use defaulted t() calls (e.g., t('stays.where', 'Where')) — this gives graceful fallback if a key is ever missing, but the keys are all present.
Pre-existing 4 ESLint duplicate-key warnings in i18n.js at lines ~628/629 and ~1608/1609 are in the older filters.saveAsAlert* keys, NOT in the new stays namespace. Out of scope per agent note.

Minor design note (not in scope): document.documentElement.dir stays 'ltr' even when i18nextLng=he. Inline Hebrew text rendering still works correctly, but a future task may want to flip dir=rtl for full RTL semantics.
